failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What films did Kamal Haasan star in that were directed by K. Balachander, the director of "Sundara Swapnagalu"?' vs Hop 3 query: 'Kamal Haasan, K. Balachander, Sundara Swapnagalu'. Both queries target the same information already retrieved in hop 1. Hop 2 returns identical documents (Sollathaan Ninaikkiren, Sundara Swapnagalu, Aakali Rajyam, Punnagai Mannan) as hop 1. Hop 3 also returns the same core documents plus additional K. Balachander-Kamal Haasan films. The summaries after hop 1 and hop 2 both conclude the claim is verified, yet queries continue to retrieve the same verification evidence rather than exploring new angles or gaps.
